company_name: Sino-platinum Metals Advanced & New Materials (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High - The company specializes in rare and precious metal sputtering targets essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sino-platinum Metals Advanced & New Materials (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and industrialization of rare and precious metal sputtering targets used in semiconductor devices. They offer a vertically integrated supply chain, including ultra-high purity raw materials, sputtering targets, and recycling services for precious metals.
capabilities: Design and supply of rare and precious metal sputtering targets
Precious metal target and waste recycling services

regional_presence.China: The company operates in Shanghai and serves both domestic and international semiconductor clients.
